# WebPerf Snippets

> Tested JavaScript snippets that measure and debug web performance. Your AI agent runs them for you, or you run them yourself in DevTools.
> Source: https://webperf-snippets.net
> Version: 2.8.0
> Each link points to the Markdown version of a page; the HTML page is at the same URL without .md.

---

## Guides

- [WebPerf Snippets CLI](https://webperf-snippets.net/CLI.md)
- [MCP server](https://webperf-snippets.net/MCP.md)
- [What agents get wrong](https://webperf-snippets.net/agent-mistakes.md)
- [DevTools extension](https://webperf-snippets.net/extension.md)
- [Which snippet should I use?](https://webperf-snippets.net/which-snippet.md)

## Core Web Vitals

- [Cumulative layout shift (CLS)](https://webperf-snippets.net/CoreWebVitals/CLS.md)
  Measures Cumulative Layout Shift, the Core Web Vital of visual stability: the largest burst of unexpected layout shifts during the life of the page.

- [Interaction to next paint (INP)](https://webperf-snippets.net/CoreWebVitals/INP.md)
  Tracks Interaction to Next Paint, the Core Web Vital of responsiveness: how fast the page responds to clicks, taps and key presses during the visit.

- [LCP image entropy](https://webperf-snippets.net/CoreWebVitals/LCP-Image-Entropy.md)
  Checks if images qualify as LCP candidates based on their entropy (bits per pixel). Since Chrome 112, low-entropy images are ignored for LCP measurement.

- [LCP subparts](https://webperf-snippets.net/CoreWebVitals/LCP-Subparts.md)
  Breaks Largest Contentful Paint into its four phases, TTFB, load delay, load time and render delay, to show which one to optimize first.

- [LCP trail](https://webperf-snippets.net/CoreWebVitals/LCP-Trail.md)
  Tracks every LCP candidate during the load and outlines each one in its own color, from the first candidate to the final LCP element.

- [LCP video candidate](https://webperf-snippets.net/CoreWebVitals/LCP-Video-Candidate.md)
  Detects whether the LCP element is a video and audits its poster, the most common source of avoidable LCP delay when a video is the hero.

- [Largest contentful paint (LCP)](https://webperf-snippets.net/CoreWebVitals/LCP.md)
  Measures Largest Contentful Paint, the Core Web Vital of loading: when the largest image or text block in the viewport renders.

## Loading

- [Back/forward cache (bfcache)](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Back-Forward-Cache.md)
  Checks whether the page can be restored from the back/forward cache, which makes back and forward navigations instant, and what keeps it out.

- [CSS complexity](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/CSS-Complexity.md)
  Finds what the CSS of the page carries and can drop: images and fonts as data: URLs, @import chains, empty rules, unused @keyframes, complex selectors.

- [CSS media queries analysis](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/CSS-Media-Queries-Analysis.md)
  Finds the @media rules for viewports wider than a breakpoint: CSS that phones download and parse without using, grouped by query and stylesheet.

- [Cache strategy analysis](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Cache-Strategy-Analysis.md)
  Audits the HTTP caching of every resource: missing or short cache lifetimes, anti-patterns and CDN cache hits, with a cache efficiency score.

- [Client-side redirect detection](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Client-Side-Redirect-Detection.md)
  Detects redirects made in JavaScript or by an SPA router, which add latency before the page renders and delay LCP, out of sight of most monitoring.

- [Compression audit](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Compression-Audit.md)
  Finds text resources served without gzip or brotli, such as scripts, stylesheets, JSON and SVG, and estimates the bytes compression would save.

- [Content visibility](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Content-Visibility.md)
  Finds the elements that use content-visibility, warns when one lacks contain-intrinsic-size, and suggests offscreen sections that could use it.

- [Critical CSS detection](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Critical-CSS-Detection.md)
  Analyzes how the page loads its CSS: render-blocking stylesheets, their size against the 14 KB budget, and whether the critical CSS is inlined.

- [Event processing time](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Event-Processing-Time.md)
  Splits the navigation into its phases, from the redirects to the load event, to show where the loading time of the page goes.

- [First contentful paint (FCP)](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/FCP.md)
  Measures First Contentful Paint: when the browser renders the first text, image, canvas or SVG, the first sign for the user that the page is loading.

- [Find above the fold lazy loaded images](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Find-Above-The-Fold-Lazy-Loaded-Images.md)
  Finds lazy-loaded images inside the viewport, an anti-pattern that delays the images users see first, and often the LCP.

- [Find images with loading lazy and fetchpriority](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Find-Images-With-Lazy-and-Fetchpriority.md)
  Detects images that have both loading="lazy" and fetchpriority="high" - a contradictory combination that indicates a misconfiguration.

- [Find non lazy loaded images outside of the viewport](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Find-non-Lazy-Loaded-Images-outside-of-the-viewport.md)
  Finds images outside the viewport that load eagerly, spending bandwidth before the page needs them, as candidates for lazy loading.

- [Find render-blocking resources](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Find-render-blocking-resources.md)
  Lists the stylesheets and scripts the browser must download and process before it renders anything, which delay FCP and LCP.

- [First and third party script info](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/First-And-Third-Party-Script-Info.md)
  Lists the scripts of the page split into first party and third party, to show how much of the page depends on external code.

- [First and third party script timings](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/First-And-Third-Party-Script-Timings.md)
  Breaks the network timing of every script into its phases, DNS, connection and response, comparing first-party and third-party scripts.

- [Fonts preloaded, loaded, and used above the fold](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Fonts-Preloaded-Loaded-and-used-above-the-fold.md)
  Compares the fonts the page preloads, the fonts it loads and the fonts it uses above the fold, to find wasted and missing preloads.

- [Get your `<head>` in order](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Get-Your-Head-in-Order.md)
  Checks the order of the elements in the head of the document: the browser processes them in sequence, so a poor order delays rendering.

- [Inline CSS info and size](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Inline-CSS-Info-and-Size.md)
  Lists the inline style elements of the page with their size, to see how much CSS the HTML carries and whether inlining it pays off.

- [Inline script info and size](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Inline-Script-Info-and-Size.md)
  Lists the inline script elements of the page with their size, to see how much JavaScript the HTML carries and what it costs the load.

- [JavaScript execution time breakdown](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/JS-Execution-Time-Breakdown.md)
  Splits the JavaScript time of the load into download and parsing, shows which scripts delay domInteractive, and flags code splitting opportunities.

- [Prefetch resource validation](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Prefetch-Resource-Validation.md)
  Checks the prefetch hints of the page: how many, how large, of which type, and whether they compete with what the current page needs.

- [Priority hints audit](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Priority-Hints-Audit.md)
  Audits fetchpriority on scripts, preloads, iframes and images, flags conflicts with preload, and finds an LCP image without fetchpriority=high.

- [Resource hints validation](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Resource-Hints-Validation.md)
  Checks whether the page uses each preload, preconnect and dns-prefetch it declares, and finds the hints that waste connections and bandwidth.

- [Resource hints](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Resource-Hints.md)
  Lists the resource hints of the page, such as preload, prefetch, preconnect and dns-prefetch, and checks how each one is used.

- [SSR framework hydration data analysis](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/SSR-Hydration-Data-Analysis.md)
  Measures the hydration data that SSR frameworks such as Next.js, Nuxt and Remix serialize into the HTML for the browser to download and parse.

- [Scripts loading](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Script-Loading.md)
  Lists every script with its loading strategy, such as async, defer or blocking, and flags the ones that block the main thread and rendering.

- [Server-Timing and Early Hints viewer](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Server-Timing-Early-Hints.md)
  Lists the Server-Timing metrics of the document and its resources and the 103 Early Hints timing, to see where the backend spends its time.

- [Service worker analysis](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Service-Worker-Analysis.md)
  Analyzes the service worker of the page: its lifecycle, the resources it serves from cache, and the startup delay it can add to TTFB.

- [Speculation rules inspector](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Speculation-Rules-Inspector.md)
  Inspects the speculation rules that prefetch and prerender the next navigations, and whether the current page was prerendered itself.

- [Time to first byte](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/TTFB.md)
  Measures Time to First Byte, from the start of the navigation to the first byte of the HTML, which reflects the server response and the network.

- [Third-party impact by domain](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Third-Party-Impact-by-Domain.md)
  Groups third-party requests by domain with their count, bytes, render blocking and main-thread time, to show which third party to fix first.

- [Validate preload on async/defer scripts](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Validate-Preload-Async-Defer-Scripts.md)
  Detects preloaded scripts that also use async or defer, an anti-pattern that raises the priority of code meant to load later.

- [Webfont usage analyzer](https://webperf-snippets.net/Loading/Webfont-Usage-Analyzer.md)
  Checks each font face against the text that renders, and reports which faces are used, which downloaded for nothing and which never loaded.

## Interaction

- [DOM size and depth](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/DOM-Size-and-Depth.md)
  Measures the number of DOM elements, the deepest nesting and the widest parent, open shadow roots included, against the Lighthouse thresholds.

- [Forced synchronous layout detector](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Forced-Synchronous-Layout.md)
  Detects forced synchronous layout as it happens: JavaScript that reads the geometry of the page right after changing styles, forcing a layout.

- [Input latency breakdown](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Input-Latency-Breakdown.md)
  Aggregates interaction latency by event type and phase over time, to show whether clicks are slower than key presses and which phase is to blame.

- [Interactions](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Interactions.md)
  Tracks every interaction as it happens and splits it into input delay, processing time and presentation delay, to debug INP.

- [Layout shift tracking](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Layout-Shift-Loading-and-Interaction.md)
  Logs every layout shift during load and interaction, with the elements that moved and when, to find what causes Cumulative Layout Shift.

- [LoAF helpers](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Long-Animation-Frames-Helpers.md)
  Utilities to analyze Long Animation Frames in depth: filter, summarize and export the frames and scripts the LoAF snippet records.

- [Long animation frames script attribution](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Long-Animation-Frames-Script-Attribution.md)
  Attributes the main-thread blocking time of long animation frames to scripts, grouped by origin: your code, framework, third parties, extensions.

- [Long animation frames (LoAF)](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Long-Animation-Frames.md)
  Tracks Long Animation Frames, the API behind INP debugging, to find the JavaScript and rendering work that blocks the main thread.

- [Long tasks](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/LongTask.md)
  Tracks the tasks that block the main thread for more than 50 ms, which keep the page from responding to input and hurt Interaction to Next Paint.

- [Scroll performance analysis](https://webperf-snippets.net/Interaction/Scroll-Performance.md)
  Measures the frame rate and the dropped frames of scrolling, and finds the non-passive listeners and the CSS that make it stutter.

## Media

- [Image element audit](https://webperf-snippets.net/Media/Image-Element-Audit.md)
  Audits every img element against image performance practices: loading strategy, fetch priority, modern formats, responsive markup, CLS prevention.

- [Oversized images](https://webperf-snippets.net/Media/Oversized-Images.md)
  Compares the pixels of each image file with the pixels it renders at, and finds images far larger than needed and images too small to look sharp.

- [SVG embedded bitmap analysis](https://webperf-snippets.net/Media/SVG-Embedded-Bitmap-Analysis.md)
  Finds SVG files and inline SVGs that embed bitmap images, with their transfer size, compression and the details of each embedded bitmap.

- [Video element audit](https://webperf-snippets.net/Media/Video-Element-Audit.md)
  Audits every video element against video performance practices: preload, autoplay, modern formats, CLS prevention and playback accessibility.

## Resources

- [Network bandwidth & connection quality](https://webperf-snippets.net/Resources/Network-Bandwidth-Connection-Quality.md)
  Reads the connection type, bandwidth, round-trip time and Save-Data of the visitor, to tell slow connections apart from slow infrastructure.

## DevTools Overrides

- [Fetch & XHR timeline](https://webperf-snippets.net/DevTools-Overrides/Fetch-XHR-Timeline.md)
  Intercepts every fetch() and XMLHttpRequest call made during the page lifecycle and correlates them with the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) timing.
